summary: The audit checks the first-year, general and programming cores, letter graded, the three seminar units (CME 300, CME 500 or 510, and one more listed seminar), nine units of research rotations, the programming, computational and depth electives, 60 units of CME 400, 18 more units of CME 400 or depth electives, and 135 units in all. You check by hand the 3.5 GPA in courses counted toward the PhD, enrolling in 8-10 units each academic-year quarter and full time in your first summer, any petitioned elective, and the qualifying exams, research forum talk, advisor alignment, candidacy form, reading committee, Green Light meeting, oral exam and dissertation.

QABmiAAe-text.why: "The coursework requirements for the ICME PhD total 57 units. Students are additionally required to take a minimum of 60 units of CME 400 ... The remaining 18 units ... can be a combination of CME 400 and additional elective courses." Those are the rules below and the 135-unit minimum; the yearly coursework deadlines are timing the audit does not check. What is left is enrollment, checked by hand: "ICME PhD students are required to take 8-10 units per quarter during the academic year." and "First-year PhD students are required to enroll full-time during their first summer quarter."
